field_mappings.transformation: trim and collapse whitespace of the whole registered_address text, preserved as provided

unmapped_fields.reason: Native bounding box metadata, not a business entity claim.
Point geometry coordinates describe the licence location point, not a business entity attribute.
Geometry type is a spatial format descriptor, not a business entity attribute.
Geometry column name is a spatial storage label, not a source claim.
Native feature identifier is a dataset row key, not a canonical entity identifier.
The ACN header is not an explicit ACN type label, and the values are bare identifiers with no same-field identifier type definition, so no typed entity.acn mapping is supported.
Attachment URL is a document link with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Extraction timestamp describes when the dataset was extracted, not an entity date_registered or validity slot.
Licence issue date concerns the permission, not the entity registration date; no whole-observation validity is established.
Licence amendment date concerns the permission record, not an entity attribute or whole-observation validity.
Licence number identifies the operating licence, not an entity ABN, ACN or other canonical identifier.
Permission activity describes the licensed activity, with no canonical ontology counterpart.
Place or premises name names the licensed site, which may differ from the business subject; not mapped to entity.legal_name or trading_name without subject evidence.
Premises address is the licensed site address, not documented as the registered address of the business subject.
Licence status value Issued has no documented equivalence to the canonical entity.status enum.
Suburb is a locality component of a site address, not a documented whole AU locality tuple for the business subject.
Native feature type is a GeoJSON format label, not a business entity attribute.
